name: Noetix N2
summary: A small, low-cost humanoid from Beijing's Noetix Robotics with 150 Nm peak-torque joints, quick-swap battery and up to 67 TOPS of edge compute. Despite the price it runs, jumps and does backflips, and Noetix N2 units took part in the 2025 Beijing humanoid half-marathon.
notable: Backflips and running on a budget mini-humanoid
Fielded in the 2025 Beijing humanoid half-marathon
